Keep original art/eye shape/costume/line thickness. The character size, crop and persistent static features should match the endpoints; do not center or shrink figures to expose more body. Even paced motion with clean gesture arcs; this is six frames of ONE small motion, not six alternate expressions. Exact action for THIS sheet: Opaque white ground. Foreground bouquet and both hands pull back slightly from viewer for wrapping. The face stays hidden. Same three ivory lilies at fixed relative positions in pink wrapping. Corners gradually reveal hair.

Draw the single precise HALFWAY posture between them, while tracing the same character design, outlines, proportions, clothes, fixed camera and solid white background. Match the crop and scale of ONE original square frame, without duplicating characters. This inbetween is a full redrawn picture, no fades or overlapping outlines. She is just barely peeking out. From center-front and wholly hidden, the girl's head has shifted only a little toward the upper LEFT of the bouquet. ONE of her warm olive eyes and a narrow bit of forehead peek out from behind the upper LEFT pink paper point. Her OTHER eye and ENTIRE mouth are still COVERED by the central lily. The large single bouquet of exactly three ivory lilies, pale gold stamens, green leaves, rose paper and pink tied bow is centered in front of her chest. Her hands hold pink paper and ribbon at bottom as before. Flower size and fixed camera match input.
